name: nao
description: Framework and chat UI for building an analytics agent grounded in your warehouse metadata, docs and rules.
whatItDoes: Lets data teams assemble the context an analytics agent needs, then hand business users a chat interface for asking questions of the warehouse. It includes a test command to measure answer quality.
howItWorks: A CLI initialises a project folder, syncs schemas, metadata and documents into a file-based context, and starts a local chat app. The agent uses that context plus configured tools and MCP servers to write and run queries against the chosen warehouse with any LLM.
